findings.summary: Product consistency between implementation_subject_commit and subject_commit was established by reading the subject tree (worktree HEAD ref h0-base = 93e9fc0), not by executing the prescribed `git diff --exit-code ... ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'`: this reviewer has read-only file inspection and no shell. No product divergence was observed — the only product changes present are the /metrics route, tests/test_metrics.py and tests/conftest.py, exactly the set the Continuous review recorded at 7859e87 — but the exclude-diff itself remains for the deterministic seal to prove.

Independently of the Continuous review's identical observation, mcp/work-folder/tests/conftest.py is a third changed file beyond the spec's two named deliverables (D1 server.py, D2 new test). It stays inside the permitted mcp/work-folder/ boundary, mirrors mcp/memory/tests/conftest.py, changes no product behaviour, and is required for the frozen acceptance gate: `pytest mcp/work-folder/tests` makes mcp/work-folder the rootdir, so mcp/conftest.py is above confcutdir and never loaded, leaving test_migrate_flat.py:15 `import scripts.migrate_flat` unresolvable. Acceptable as delivered.
